product: Control spreadsheet writeback with a workspace admin setting
tagline: Excel and Google Sheets writeback now requires a workspace admin to enable the Allow spreadsheet writeback security setting.
what_it_does: Excel and Google Sheets writeback now requires a workspace admin to enable the Allow spreadsheet writeback security setting. The Databricks Connector for Google Sheets lets you write data from Google Sheets back to a Unity Catalog table. You can create a new table or overwrite an existing table in Databricks without leaving Google Sheets.
